scientific_scope_status: Actual acquired model records support a partial-likelihood receiver using marked counts, total-vacancy residence histograms, bounded reward flags, known graph geometry and two controlled baseline coefficients. A completed substantive independent review accepts the actual finite-model, ideal-law and standalone-access scope.

unavailable_or_unclassified: N744 assumes a single distinct microscopic source per rank-one actuator. The stated CO adsorption operator has rank3^M-2^M and violates that application premise; this does not invalidate N744 scoped mathematics. Same-information ordinary likelihood/graph methods reproduce the new envelope, and direct KMC wins the tested small-query full cycle. Actual seeded binary64 records do not prove ideal-IID/Gillespie or physical laws. Physical acquisition, product selection, long-time/bulk advantage and historical priority remain unestablished.
